title: AI voice-clone Biden robocalls (New Hampshire primary)
summary: Two days before the January 2024 New Hampshire primary, 9,581 robocalls carried a generative-AI voice imitating President Biden urging voters not to vote, with the caller ID spoofed to a local political figure's household. The FCC found that consultant Steve Kramer supplied the script and that the audio was generated with commercial voice-cloning software for $150. The FCC proposed a $6 million forfeiture against Kramer in May 2024 and imposed it in September 2024 under the Truth in Caller ID Act; Lingo Telecom, the originating carrier that applied incorrect caller-authentication attestations, settled for a $1 million civil penalty and a compliance plan in August 2024. In June 2025 a New Hampshire jury acquitted Kramer of state voter-suppression and candidate-impersonation charges. The case is included because it shows how convincing a cloned voice on a phone call can be.
